display_information.name: Jacob's Clone
display_information.description: Your personal auto-responder. Set a canned reply, a wait time and an expiry — when someone messages your channels, it replies as you.
display_information.long_description:
Jacob's Clone is a personal auto-responder for your workspace.

How it works:
• You open the app's Home tab and create an auto-responder.
• Pick a channel (the bot must be a member), the reply text, how long to wait, and when it expires (up to 3 days).
• When someone sends a message there, the app waits, then posts your canned reply AS YOU (it uses your user token, so the reply is fully yours — you can even edit or delete it).

This is a single-user app: only the person who installs it can use it.
